reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, nxt.valid_from AS changed_on, nxt.list_price_eur - old.list_price_eur AS change_eur
FROM products p
JOIN price_history old ON old.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN price_history nxt ON nxt.product_id = old.product_id AND nxt.valid_from = old.valid_to + 1
WHERE p.brand = 'Vistara' AND nxt.valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
alternatives: SELECT p.product_name, nxt.valid_from AS changed_on, nxt.list_price_eur - old.list_price_eur AS change_eur FROM price_history old JOIN price_history nxt ON nxt.product_id = old.product_id AND old.valid_to = nxt.valid_from - 1 JOIN products p ON p.product_id = nxt.product_id WHERE p.brand = 'Vistara' AND year(nxt.valid_from) = 2025

WITH next_start AS (SELECT a.product_id, a.valid_from, MIN(b.valid_from) AS next_from FROM price_history a JOIN price_history b ON b.product_id = a.product_id AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from GROUP BY a.product_id, a.valid_from) SELECT p.product_name, n.next_from AS changed_on, nxt.list_price_eur - old.list_price_eur AS change_eur FROM next_start n JOIN products p ON p.product_id = n.product_id JOIN price_history old ON old.product_id = n.product_id AND old.valid_from = n.valid_from JOIN price_history nxt ON nxt.product_id = n.product_id AND nxt.valid_from = n.next_from WHERE p.brand = 'Vistara' AND n.next_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

solver.query:
SELECT p.product_name, n.valid_from AS changed_on, n.list_price_eur - o.list_price_eur AS change_eur
FROM price_history n
JOIN price_history o ON o.product_id = n.product_id AND o.valid_to + 1 = n.valid_from
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = n.product_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Vistara'
  AND n.valid_from >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND n.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31'
